projects.title: Stallion Honda Showroom
projects.summary: A flagship showroom and workshop building on the Faizabad Road — a clean glass-and-steel volume that lets the brand and the cars take centre stage.
projects.description: Conceived as a long, low-rise pavilion stretched along the highway, the building wraps a triple-height showroom in a continuous glass envelope. The service workshop is set behind a deep cantilevered overhang that doubles as the customer drop-off. A dark stone plinth grounds the building to the avenue, while horizontal aluminium fins modulate the strong westerly sun without ever interrupting the view of the cars.

projects.title: Jewellers Flagship Store
projects.summary: A jewel of a façade — a layered street face that catches the light the way the merchandise does.
projects.description: The brief was simple: a building that feels as crafted as the jewellery inside it. The street face is a sequence of recessed bays, each lit independently, so the façade reads like a long, illuminated cabinet at night. Inside, the showroom is conceived as a single, hushed room with display vitrines arranged like islands in a quiet sea of plaster and oak.

projects.title: Aquatic Centre
projects.summary: A swimming pool building organised around a single, generous span — daylight from above, shadow from the sides.
projects.description: An indoor swimming complex with a clear-span steel roof structure that allows the pool hall to be column-free. North-facing clerestory windows provide an even, shadowless light all day, while solid southern walls keep the heat out. A linear changing block runs along one side, separated from the pool deck by a shaded outdoor terrace.

projects.title: Boutique Resort
projects.summary: A small village of pitched-roof pavilions arranged along a slow, treed approach.
projects.description: The resort is laid out as a loose village of low pavilions threaded between mature trees. Locally fired brick, timber and lime-washed walls give the architecture a quiet, regional character. The longest move is the approach itself — a 200-metre walk under a canopy of trees that ends at the central courtyard, with all rooms opening onto private gardens.

projects.title: Banquet Hall
projects.summary: A flexible event venue — one large hall that can become two, three or many small rooms.
projects.description: A modern banquet venue conceived around a single column-free hall and a series of operable partitions. The central space can host a single 700-person event or be subdivided into smaller, more intimate rooms for daily use. A wraparound landscaped terrace doubles the usable area in the cooler months.

projects.title: Ambalika Institute Campus
projects.summary: An institutional building organised around a generous central court — daylight, calm, and a clear circulation spine.
projects.description: The Ambalika building is arranged as four wings folded around a planted central court. Classrooms and labs face the perimeter for daylight; circulation runs around the court so every room is just one threshold from open air. The façade is a deep, unfussy composition of concrete bands and recessed glazing, calibrated to handle Lucknow's strong summer sun.

projects.title: Kalra Residence
projects.summary: A family residence designed around a single mature mango tree at the heart of the plot.
projects.description: The Kalra Residence is organised as three wings folded around a central court anchored by the existing mango tree. Concrete fins articulate the western face, slowing the afternoon light into soft horizontal bands; the eastern wing opens fully to the morning sun via a deep, shaded verandah. Materials were drawn from the site's own context — local sandstone, lime plaster, teak.

projects.title: Modern Villa
projects.summary: A contemporary villa — clean horizontal lines, a deep cantilever, and a stone plinth that grounds the volume.
projects.description: Conceived as a horizontal composition of three stacked floors, the villa is grounded by a stone plinth and crowned by a deep cantilevered slab that shades the upper terraces. The living spaces face the south garden through a continuous wall of openable sliding glass, while the bedrooms are tucked into the cooler north side.

projects.title: Greenfield Township
projects.summary: A 42-acre township master-plan built around a continuous green spine — walkable, planted, unhurried.
projects.description: Greenfield is a 42-acre township in which the central spine is not a road but a continuous landscape — a pedestrian green that links every cluster, school and community building. The vehicular network is pushed to the perimeter, allowing the inner blocks to be unhurried and densely planted. Two- and three-BHK villas occupy the inner clusters; larger four-BHK villas line the perimeter green.

projects.title: Studio Office Interior
projects.summary: An office tuned for focus — a continuous oak spine, soft north light, and a single long communal table.
projects.description: The office is treated as one continuous loft, anchored by a 24-foot communal worktable. Private cabins are tucked behind a long, full-height oak library that doubles as the firm's archive. Materials are deliberately quiet — washed oak, raw plaster, brushed brass — and the lighting is calibrated almost entirely for paper and screens.
